payload.swept:
EVERYTHING THIS ITERATION CHANGED, AND THE SURFACE THAT TEACHES IT. A doc still teaching the superseded way is a defect here, so each change is listed with what was updated or with why nothing needed to be.

1. IDENTIFIERS ARE EXPANDED WHERE THEY ARE READ (R36). SWEPT — brand/voice.md gains an 'Identifiers' section: expand every identifier in the message that uses it, prefer the plain phrase, an unexpanded id reads as precision and carries nothing.
  WHY THIS ONE MATTERS MOST: it is the only rule in this iteration whose home is the CONTRACT, which the boot serves in full to every session. Until now it lived in my memory, which does not travel between machines and does not survive a fresh agent. That is the same defect this iteration is about, one level up — and it was the rule TELLING me to communicate readably.
  KNOWN CONSEQUENCE, stated because it is deliberate: voice.md is embedded in the contract, so editing it changes the contract hash. Every session re-attests. That is the correct cost for a rule that must bind everyone.

2. THE SEARCH ARCHITECTURE REVERSED — two providers, one per job. SWEPT IN THE LEDGER, which is where the why lives once: se.adr-search-is-two-jobs records the decision, and se.adr-git-is-the-only-searcher was rewritten IN PLACE to say it is superseded, why its conclusion fell, and what of its analysis survives. A reader arriving at the old node is told immediately that it no longer holds.
  NO PROSE DOC TEACHES THE OLD WAY — checked. The hand-rolled searcher was engine-internal and is deleted, so there is no surface still describing it.

3. THE TOOL SURFACE GREW BY FOUR TOOLS — promotion, configuration, glob, reopen. SWEPT AUTOMATICALLY, and this is worth naming as a design property rather than as work I did: the contract's lane list is generated from the SERVED REGISTRY at boot, not hand-maintained. The rule in the contract says it plainly — the contract can never name a lane the surface does not serve. All four appear because they are served. A hand-written list would already be wrong.

4. THE REVIEW ROUNDS ARE NOW COLLECTED. SWEPT AT THE SOURCE. The rounds are injected where evidence forms are built, and their field DESCRIPTIONS carry the rubric — a bless is not proof, cite a rubric not vibes, name the kill-criterion, log an override with its dissent. The method note said the compiler would inject them; it now does, so the note and the machine agree for the first time.
  THE DELIBERATE CHOICE HERE: the rubric lives in the field description rather than in a note the agent must go and find. That is this iteration's own principle applied to itself — a rule the agent must chase is a rule it will not read.

5. REOPEN EXISTS. SWEPT — se.adr-reopen-supersedes-and-rearms records the semantics including the third clause that two live deadlocks produced. Twelve ledger nodes already SPECIFIED reopen while the engine contained the word zero times; those nodes are now true rather than aspirational, so nothing there needed rewriting.

6. ENGINE PROMOTION IS A REAL STEP. SWEPT — se.adr-engine-promotes-to-trunk carries the four rules, the honest cost (engine code reaches trunk before its own gates review it), and the known limit (the promotion cannot deliver a fix to itself).

7. THE ONE-CLICK BAR NOW HAS A DEFINITION. SWEPT — se.decision-one-click-means-runme-on-three-platforms records the owner's ruling, the three platforms in scope, that exotic distributions are out, and that a failed install may simply tell the user what to install. This criterion had been weighed at maximum weight for two milestones with no definition, and it decided an architecture.

8. THE CONSOLE-WINDOW OBLIGATION. SWEPT AS A LINT rather than as a doc, deliberately: a deliberate choice that must survive future edits gets a check, not a comment. The lint names the reason in its own header, so the next person to add a spawn learns it from a red suite rather than from a paragraph they would not have read.

WHAT I DID NOT SWEEP, and why each is a decision rather than an omission:
  THE RUNME SCRIPT — unchanged. The owner ruled it is the Windows entry point by design and the cloud targets carry their own setup scripts. What is needed is that the install be SCRIPTABLE, which it already is. Recorded as a lead, not a defect.
  THE MACHINE'S OWN GUIDANCE TEXT — unchanged. Rewriting method content is on this iteration's binding excluded list. Where a method note and the machine disagreed, I changed the MACHINE.
  THE BOOK AND THE README — untouched. Nothing this iteration changed is visible to a stranger reading the front door; the whole surface is agent-facing.

THE GAP THIS SWEEP ITSELF EXPOSES: the sweep worked because I remembered what changed. There is no mechanical check that a change reached its describing surface, and three register gaps found this iteration were all discovered the same way — by someone noticing. That is the same shape as everything else here, and it is exactly what the next iteration's tag-joined guidance library is for.
